messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. [shared_instruction:scientific_instructions]Independently verify whether control evidence is present. If controls are withheld or unavailable, explicitly mark controls_unavailable and set screen_status to incomplete. Do not treat missing controls as a negative biological result or a failure. Use control_overlap only if control evidence is present. Reconcile any contradictions between the evidence inventory and the screen status. [shared_instruction:answer_contract] Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Select relevant deterministic calculations. Obtain targeted and control counts, explicit overlap numerators and denominators, duplicate/unmapped identifiers, and distances using tools. Prioritize a missing control or proximity calculation that could change the interpretation. Do not do interval arithmetic yourself.

{"conclusion": "The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding candidate keppel-19, and it also does not establish that the region is safe. Targeted Keppel-19 H1 cultures show 139 significant DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260 significant DE genes (194 up, 66 down) against the same reference. The two sets share only 48 genes (Jaccard 48/351 = 0.1368; 48/139 = 0.3453 of targeted; 48/260 = 0.1846 of control), all 48 in the same direction, with 91 targeted-only and 212 control-only genes. The untargeted control therefore carries a larger significant DE burden than the targeted clone, so the targeted expression changes are not distinguishable from ordinary untargeted H1 variation by count alone. Genomic proximity is also non-informative for exclusion: of 139 targeted DE genes, 130 mapped to GENCODE v36, 9 were unmapped (noncanonical contigs/patches), and only 4 mapped DE genes lie on chr19; the nearest, AC011471.1, is 774,117 bp away (nearest_reference_base_distance_bp; interval_gap_bp 774,116), with no overlap. All seven required annotation criteria (outside_gene_body, tss_distance, mirna_distance, lncrna_distance, cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer, outside_ultraconserved_regions) remain incomplete, and cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved sources are unavailable. experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19. In H1, the targeted clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted control shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared (overlap fraction 48/139 = 0.3453), leaving 91 targeted-only genes. Because 48 of the targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control, a substantial part of the targeted signal is not specific to the targeted clone, but the 91 targeted-only genes and the 212 control-only genes show the two sets are not equivalent. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, so the expression comparison contextualizes a concern rather than resolving it. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53,277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53,278 bp; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774,116 bp away by interval gap. These distances are proximity measurements only and cannot establish safety or cis causality. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, and 9 DE identifiers could not be mapped to canonical GENCODE v36 coordinates. The qPCR endpoint (MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4) reports near-zero mean log2 fold changes but has no exclusion threshold and does not establish safety. Overall suitability is not established.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. proposal.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19. In H1, the targeted clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted control shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared (overlap fraction 48/139 = 0.3453), leaving 91 targeted-only genes. Because 48 of the targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control, a substantial part of the targeted signal is not specific to the targeted clone, but the 91 targeted-only genes and the 212 control-only genes show the two sets are not equivalent. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, so the expression comparison contextualizes a concern rather than resolving it. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53,277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53,278 bp; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774,116 bp away by interval gap. These distances are proximity measurements only and cannot establish safety or cis causality. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, and 9 DE identifiers could not be mapped to canonical GENCODE v36 coordinates. The qPCR endpoint (MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4) reports near-zero mean log2 fold changes but has no exclusion threshold and does not establish safety. Overall suitability is not established.

Can the 9 unmapped DE identifiers (noncanonical/alt/patch contigs) be resolved to canonical GRCh38 coordinates to complete the proximity analysis?
Why does the workbook contain 139 qualifying targeted rows while the article prose reports 119? The discrepancy is unresolved and no rows were removed.
Do the near-zero qPCR means for MAGI3, TXNL1 and ZNRF4 indicate absence of effect at those loci, or simply lack of power/significance? No exclusion threshold is defined.
Is any observed expression change causally attributable to the candidate region rather than to the targeting construct (CASP9 is in the construct) or to independent untargeted variation?
limitations: Expression tables are significant-only DEseq2 results; they are not raw counts and do not represent the full measured-gene universe, so absence of a row is not evidence of no expression or no biological effect.
GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome; coordinates and annotations are reference-based.
GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification used in the publication.

criteria.source_section: Materials and methods: In silico search for putative GSH
criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19 under the frozen criteria. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3453. Because the control arm itself carries substantial DE signal, overlap alone cannot attribute the targeted changes to the candidate region, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the interval outside any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53278 bp, both passing the >50000 bp TSS criterion; miRNA (MIR4747, 468021 bp) and lncRNA (AC005790.1, 106065 bp) distances also pass. However, the screen remains incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be issued. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) lies 774116 bp away. These are publication-derived, significant-only tables on GRCh38 reference coordinates, not a personalized H1 genome, and they cannot establish biological safety or causality.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19 under the frozen criteria. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3453. Because the control arm itself carries substantial DE signal, overlap alone cannot attribute the targeted changes to the candidate region, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the interval outside any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53278 bp, both passing the >50000 bp TSS criterion; miRNA (MIR4747, 468021 bp) and lncRNA (AC005790.1, 106065 bp) distances also pass. However, the screen remains incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be issued. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) lies 774116 bp away. These are publication-derived, significant-only tables on GRCh38 reference coordinates, not a personalized H1 genome, and they cannot establish biological safety or causality.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Read the named criteria and their parameters. Report all required missing criteria, including unavailable cancer-gene/regulatory evidence. Never infer an overall pass from the available subset.

Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Select relevant deterministic calculations. Obtain targeted and control counts, explicit overlap numerators and denominators, duplicate/unmapped identifiers, and distances using tools. Prioritize a missing control or proximity calculation that could change the interpretation. Do not do interval arithmetic yourself.

proposal.conclusion: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding candidate keppel-19, and it also does not establish that the region is safe. Targeted Keppel-19 H1 cultures show 139 significant DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260 significant DE genes (194 up, 66 down) against the same reference. The two sets share only 48 genes (Jaccard 48/351 = 0.1368; 48/139 = 0.3453 of targeted; 48/260 = 0.1846 of control), all 48 in the same direction, with 91 targeted-only and 212 control-only genes. The untargeted control therefore carries a larger significant DE burden than the targeted clone, so the targeted expression changes are not distinguishable from ordinary untargeted H1 variation by count alone. Genomic proximity is also non-informative for exclusion: of 139 targeted DE genes, 130 mapped to GENCODE v36, 9 were unmapped (noncanonical contigs/patches), and only 4 mapped DE genes lie on chr19; the nearest, AC011471.1, is 774,117 bp away (nearest_reference_base_distance_bp; interval_gap_bp 774,116), with no overlap. All seven required annotation criteria (outside_gene_body, tss_distance, mirna_distance, lncrna_distance, cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer, outside_ultraconserved_regions) remain incomplete, and cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved sources are unavailable. Aggregate status is incomplete; no global safe label and no exclusion decision can be issued.
unresolved_questions: Do the 139 targeted DE genes and 260 untargeted-control DE genes differ beyond count and set overlap, e.g. in effect-size distribution or pathway composition? Not computed here.
Why does the workbook contain 139 threshold-qualifying rows while the article prose reports 119? Source discrepancy is unresolved and no rows were removed to force agreement.
What are the GENCODE v36 gene-body overlap count and nearest TSS, miRNA and lncRNA distances for keppel-19? These required criteria have no attached computed result.
What are the COSMIC v92 cancer-gene, ENCFF503GCK DHS+2kb and versioned ultraconserved-region distances/overlaps? Sources are unavailable, so these criteria cannot be evaluated.
Do the 9 unmapped DE identifiers (noncanonical contigs/patches, e.g. CHR_HSCHR6_MHC_QBL_CTG1, CHR_HG926_PATCH) change the proximity picture? They prevent a claim about all DE genes.
What is the all-measured-gene denominator? Tables are significant-only, so no inference of zero expression or absence of biological effects is possible.
Do the qPCR means for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210) indicate any effect? No exclusion threshold is defined and significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.
limitations: Expression tables are significant-only DEseq2 results, not raw counts or the full measured-gene universe; omitted rows are not evidence of no effect.
Counts were recomputed from published tables; DEseq2 was not rerun from sequencing reads.
GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome.
GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 quantification.
Control overlap and genomic proximity cannot establish safety, causality or cis regulation.
No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion; no global safe label is assigned.
CASP9 is included in the targeting construct; RNA-seq counts do not distinguish construct from endogenous transcription.
H9 results are a separate cell context and are not generalized to H1.
Missing evidence (cancer-gene, DHS, ultraconserved, gene-body/TSS/miRNA/lncRNA distances) remains incomplete, not a negative biological result.

Because 48 of the targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control, a substantial part of the targeted signal is not specific to the targeted clone, but the 91 targeted-only genes and the 212 control-only genes show the two sets are not equivalent. distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19 under the frozen criteria. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3453. Because the control arm itself carries substantial DE signal, overlap alone cannot attribute the targeted changes to the candidate region, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the interval outside any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53278 bp, both passing the >50000 bp TSS criterion; miRNA (MIR4747, 468021 bp) and lncRNA (AC005790.1, 106065 bp) distances also pass. However, the screen remains incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be issued. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) lies 774116 bp away. These are publication-derived, significant-only tables on GRCh38 reference coordinates, not a personalized H1 genome, and they cannot establish biological safety or causality.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. {"conclusion": "The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19 under the frozen criteria. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3453. Because the control arm itself carries substantial DE signal, overlap alone cannot attribute the targeted changes to the candidate region, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the interval outside any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53278 bp, both passing the >50000 bp TSS criterion; miRNA (MIR4747, 468021 bp) and lncRNA (AC005790.1, 106065 bp) distances also pass. However, the screen remains incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be issued. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) lies 774116 bp away. proposal.conclusion: The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19 under the frozen criteria. The targeted Keppel-19 H1 clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 control shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3453. Because the control arm itself carries substantial DE signal, overlap alone cannot attribute the targeted changes to the candidate region, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. GENCODE v36 places the interval outside any annotated transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53278 bp, both passing the >50000 bp TSS criterion; miRNA (MIR4747, 468021 bp) and lncRNA (AC005790.1, 106065 bp) distances also pass. However, the screen remains incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass can be issued. Of the 139 targeted DE genes, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 do not; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) lies 774116 bp away. These are publication-derived, significant-only tables on GRCh38 reference coordinates, not a personalized H1 genome, and they cannot establish biological safety or causality.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19. In H1, the targeted clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted control shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared (overlap fraction 48/139 = 0.3453), leaving 91 targeted-only genes. Because 48 of the targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control, a substantial part of the targeted signal is not specific to the targeted clone, but the 91 targeted-only genes and the 212 control-only genes show the two sets are not equivalent. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, so the expression comparison contextualizes a concern rather than resolving it. GENCODE v36 places the candidate outside any annotated gene body (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53,277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53,278 bp; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774,116 bp away by interval gap. These distances are proximity measurements only and cannot establish safety or cis causality. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, and 9 DE identifiers could not be mapped to canonical GENCODE v36 coordinates. The qPCR endpoint (MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4) reports near-zero mean log2 fold changes but has no exclusion threshold and does not establish safety. Overall suitability is not established.

criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

input_contract.gene_unit: unique versioned Ensembl gene identifier; version-stripped counts also reported
input_contract.comparison: targeted clone or independent untargeted culture versus reference untargeted cells of same H1/H9 context
input_contract.h9_policy: Separate biological context; no automatic generalization to H1
input_contract.interpretive_conclusions: Excluded from worker inputs; only tables, methods metadata and annotations are provided

limitations: Publication-derived shortlist; no new whole-genome search.
GRCh38 reference is not a personalized H1 genome.
GENCODE v36 is a new versioned annotation analysis.
Required cancer-gene and regulatory exclusion evidence is unavailable.

coverage.completeness_definition: All overlapping rows from both frozen UCSC v36 transcript tables; canonical chromosomes only.

annotation.analysis_note: New GENCODE v36 analysis; not an exact reproduction of the publication annotation pipeline.

provenance.source: Frozen source catalog; original sequence and annotation hashes retained inside reference_assets.

limitations: Runtime checkpoints are separate from application acceptance transactions.
Genome base counts are not model token counts.
Original experimental workbooks remain external immutable artifacts identified by their recorded URLs and byte hashes.
